newsitem.title: SYRIA: Islamic Jihad calls for fight against Israelis.
newsitem.headline: Islamic Jihad calls for fight against Israelis.

text.p: The Islamic Jihad group on Thursday called on its fighters to attack Israeli targets after clashes broke out in Palestinian self-rule areas.

Ramadan Abdullah, secretary-general of the Islamic Jihad, said in a statement that Arab and Islamic states should support the Palestinians in the clashes that broke out Wednesday between Israeli troops and Palestinians in the Gaza Strip and West Bank.
The fighting, in which 33 Palestinians and 10 Israelis have died, started after Israel opened a tunnel next to an important Moslem shrine in Jerusalem's Old City.
"We call on our mujahideen (holy fighters) to escalate the military struggle against the gatherings and targets of the Zionist enemy in defence of our people..," Abdullah said in his statement.
The statement urged the Palestinian Authority to stop negotiations with Israel and to free all prisoners in its jails.
The Islamic Jihad has claimed responsibility for several fatal attacks on Israelis since the PLO signed a peace deal with Israel in 1993.
